data.title: Choose the correct answer for each question

sections.title: Candour
sections.sentence: I was impressed by the candor of his statement
sections.summary: She spoke with candour about the challenges she faced
sections.explain: Candour means being open and honest

words.word: The quality of being open and honest; frankness
The quality of being sweet and nice

sections.title: Ubiquitous
sections.summary: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern society
sections.explain: Ubiquitous means present, appearing, or found everywhere

sections.title: Ephemeral
sections.summary: The beauty of the sunset was ephemeral, lasting only a few minutes
sections.explain: Ephemeral means lasting for a very short time

words.word: Lasting for a very short time

sections.title: Obfuscate
sections.summary: The company tried to obfuscate the facts with complex language
sections.explain: Obfuscate means to make something unclear or difficult to understand

words.word: To make something unclear or difficult to understand
To clarify or explain in detail

sections.title: Equanimity
sections.summary: She accepted the bad news with remarkable equanimity
sections.explain: Equanimity means mental calmness and composure, especially in a difficult situation

words.word: Mental calmness and composure, especially in a difficult situation
A tendency to be easily excited

sections.title: Magnanimous
sections.sentence: She was very magnanimous in victory
sections.summary: Despite losing the match, he was magnanimous in defeat
sections.explain: Magnanimous means very generous or forgiving, especially toward a rival or someone less powerful

words.word: Very generous or forgiving, especially toward a rival or someone less powerful

sections.title: Inscrutable
sections.summary: Her expression was inscrutable, giving nothing away
sections.explain: Inscrutable means impossible to understand or interpret

words.word: Very clear and easy to read

sections.title: Perfunctory
sections.summary: He gave a perfunctory nod and continued on his way
sections.explain: Perfunctory means carried out with minimum effort or reflection

words.word: Carried out with minimum effort or reflection

sections.title: Obsequious
sections.summary: His obsequious behavior annoyed his colleagues
sections.explain: Obsequious means excessively eager to please or obey someone

words.word: Excessively eager to please or obey someone

sections.title: Quixotic
sections.summary: His quixotic quest for perfection often led to disappointment
sections.explain: Quixotic means exceedingly idealistic; unrealistic and impractical

words.word: Related to quick thinking or intelligence
